title: Keep a derived image helper rendering versioned markup
goal: Update a custom ImageTagHelper when moving MVC or Razor Pages to ASP.NET Core 11: use the supported three-service constructor and remove reads of the retired HostingEnvironment and Cache properties.

selectionNotes: Update a custom ImageTagHelper when moving MVC or Razor Pages to ASP.NET Core 11: use the supported three-service constructor and remove reads of the retired HostingEnvironment and Cache properties.
Historical .NET 10 code is comparison-only. The supported replacement already worked on .NET 10; these samples do not add a curated foundation.

runtime.name: .NET / ASP.NET Core
runtime.reason: An ASP.NET Core 11 migration; the recorded execution baseline is RC2, not GA.

frameworks: ASP.NET Core MVC / Razor Pages Tag Helpers
packageAssets: Matching Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework and reference pack; no additional NuGet package
providers: Real Razor activation, physical web-root file provider and IFileVersionProvider; no application data provider
platforms: ASP.NET Core supported server platforms; actual evidence is Windows x64
renderingModes: Server-rendered Razor views or Razor Pages; not Blazor components
prerequisites: Create the complete FernPosters directory for one target, including the three empty Directory files that isolate surrounding MSBuild/central package configuration. Use the pinned SDK and restore framework assets before offline builds. Run with the sample directory as the working directory.
constraints: MVC and Razor Pages Tag Helpers only; this constructor migration does not apply to Blazor img elements.

Removed members are the five-argument constructor, protected HostingEnvironment and protected Cache. The three-argument constructor is not a new .NET 11 invention. Arbitrary precompiled subclasses must be rebuilt.

Both built-in and derived image helpers can match the same element when imported together. Import the replacement deliberately; the sample imports only its own assembly. For selective coexistence, choose mutually exclusive targets or scopes.

Versioning requires the real web-root file provider to find the image. A missing local asset may keep an unversioned URL. This sample tests generated markup with a local file, not browser image loading, a CDN or production cache invalidation.
stabilityLimitations: Stable framework migration; .NET 11 compilation and execution evidence uses 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105. GA reconciliation remains separate.
